description: NVIDIA NIM exposes hosted and self-hosted OpenAI-compatible inference endpoints for NVIDIA and partner models.

sources.notes: Official hosted NIM model API references document the shared integrate.api.nvidia.com Chat Completions endpoint and model-specific schemas.
Official self-hosted NIM reference documents Chat Completions, Completions, Responses, Anthropic Messages, streaming, tools, usage, management endpoints, and the absence of Batch support.

verification.notes: Hosted Chat transport/authentication and configurable self-hosted NIM transport verified against first-party NVIDIA references.
